items.q: Panama Francis -- Arnett Cobb. And I was co-starrin' that -- between the two of us, we were both leaders.

ctx.x: No no no. They got it together over there. Called whoever they want. So I had been over there before, and I did a good job with Milt. Then I was over there again with
... Panama Francis -- Arnett Cobb. And I was co-starrin' that -- between the two of us, we were both leaders.
